scripts.start: npm run front & npm run widget
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode production && npm run --workspace=widget build
scripts.prod: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode production && npm run --workspace=widget build
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:build && npm run test:docs
scripts.test:build: node --experimental-test-module-mocks --test vite.plugins.test.js scripts/verify-ui-version.test.js scripts/update-skateboard.test.js scripts/version-consistency.test.js scripts/widget-source.test.js
